astraCeilingFirstPrecedence.context: VAL-LIVE-004 expects `Daily budget reached for this wallet.` for the astra call while the ceiling 0.05 is also in force.
astraCeilingFirstPrecedence.observation: With ceiling 50000 and own 30000, the astra quote 69000 exceeds both, and the contract's check order (architecture §2.5; VAL-LEDGER-015; src/store.ts holdSpend checks the owner ceiling first) returns `Daily budget set by the agent owner is reached.`.
astraCeilingFirstPrecedence.resolution: Recorded both variants live: with the ceiling in force the owner message (step VAL-LIVE-004.1), and with only the own 0.03 value in force the exact text the assertion names (step VAL-LIVE-004.1b). The product behaviour matches the authoritative precedence rule and the unit-tested VAL-LEDGER-015; no production code was changed in this feature.
